name: ism-default-service-accounts

provenance.rationale: The local detector combines C-0189's checks for default-account token automount and a dedicated non-default ServiceAccount in each scanned namespace.

description: Fail namespaces with no non-default ServiceAccount and default ServiceAccounts that may automount API tokens.
remediation: Create a dedicated ServiceAccount for each namespace that needs Kubernetes API access, and set automountServiceAccountToken: false on each default ServiceAccount.
